structure.en: who uses Pokémon that live in water

structure.jp: プロフェッショナルだ！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: みずに　すむ　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed right before a thing, describes that thing. Here it happens twice in a row. みずに　すむ　ポケモン = 'Pokémon that live in water'.
